## Problem and change

Describe the user-visible problem and the resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` for browser, host, transport or MCP changes
- [ ] `npm run test:package` for installation or distribution changes

Include relevant environment details and results. Explain any check that was not run.

## Review notes

- Describe changes to permissions, grants, ownership, revocation or uncertain write outcomes.
- Keep English and Chinese setup instructions aligned when behavior changes.
- Exclude credentials, personal paths, browser profiles and private page data from the diff and attachments.
